blocks.text: 1. Executive Summary

From 20 July to 19 November 2026 AI (Claude Code) was part of my daily SAP ABAP delivery on three concurrent projects. **74 AI-assisted developments were completed** - ONGC (OVL) 51, T&G 12, PAL 6 and 5 common tools - with **867 commits in under four months**, 150,384 lines of code and 312 custom SAP objects.
The same scope needs 1,618 h conventionally; it took 592 h with AI - **128 man-days saved, a 63% effort reduction**.
2. Scope and Sources Reviewed

items: Every object folder of the work repository for PAL, ONGC (OVL), T&G and common tools, with its issue log and technical notes.
Git history of 66 branches: 867 commits, 19/08 - 19/11/26; Claude Code session records 20/07 - 15/08/26 (30 sessions, 557 prompts).
The August OVL work log, ATC exports, manual review list, ATC knowledge base and handover, FS / TS documents and client feedback.

blocks.text: 6. ATC Correction and Code Optimisation Summary
ATC S/4HANA-readiness remediation for ONGC: 88 h conventional vs 41 h with AI - **47 h saved (54%)**.

blocks.caption: ATC remediation - findings identified to corrections implemented
rows: Objects (includes) in the assigned ATC scope
107 pragma / pseudo-comment, 65 replaced with the original kept commented, 33 new code
Findings routed for functional / senior decision
P1 field-length decisions, XK01 BDC, BSEG statements
Objects packaged for abapGit upload with procedure
Rule audit across all corrected objects before handover
Knowledge base plus 31 activation / runtime rules

items: Findings resolved: SELECT SINGLE without unique key (NOORDER), field-length extension, simplified objects (BSEG, KONV, VBUK / VBUP, J_1IMOVEND), CLIENT SPECIFIED on compatibility views, strict Open SQL, pseudo-comments with SAP notes.

Code optimisation beyond ATC: FOR ALL ENTRIES with implicit DISTINCT replaced by ranges (ZFITAX_PBT_CALC_PRG), BDC on dead S/4 transactions replaced by FI-AA BAPIs (ZAA_IMPAIRMENTLOSS), guarded FOR ALL ENTRIES and aggregation on the database.

blocks.text: 8. Quantified Effort and Productivity Analysis

Effort without AI 1,618 h; with AI 592 h; saved 1,025 h = 128 man-days; reduction 63%; productivity improvement 173%. Saved = without - with; reduction = saved / without; man-days = saved / 8. Conventional effort comes from a baseline by work type and complexity; AI-assisted effort counts the full development time of the period, distributed by measured session time per object. The formula-driven calculation is in the Excel register.

blocks.text: 9. Customer Benefits

items: Capacity released: 128 man-days in four months, used to carry three projects concurrently.
Faster delivery: working versions typically within a working day; earlier functional testing.
Reusable assets: ATC correction patterns, release constraints, forecast engine, workflow class and analytical cube patterns, five developer tools.
Potential effort value = man-days saved x applicable day rate (margin and capacity under fixed price; per the billing arrangement under T&M).

blocks.text: 10. Overall Conclusions

**Success story - ONGC Videsh JIB Status dashboard:** eight CDS views with an analytical cube, from requirement (03/11/26) to written client confirmation (17/11/26) in 11 working days; 60 h conventional delivered in 16 h (73% reduction). Details in the attached deck.

items: AI is part of daily delivery: 74 completed use cases and 867 commits in under four months across PAL, ONGC and T&G.
128 man-days saved (63%) with human control at every step: fresh source download, activation feedback, functional confirmation.
Next steps: share the AI delivery toolkit with the team, extend the dashboard pattern, apply the ATC patterns to the next remediation wave, log effort per object.
